name: cloud-api
description: Scaffold a resource that represents credentials, endpoint configuration, and connectivity validation for a hosted API.

RESOURCE_PORTABILITY_TIER.description: Portability tier for the generated scaffold.

RESOURCE_ENDPOINT.description: Base URL or health endpoint for the hosted API.

RESOURCE_CREDENTIAL_ENV.description: Primary environment variable checked for credentials.

platformExpectations: The local control plane should validate credentials and connectivity without pretending to own the hosted service runtime.
Secrets should be referenced, not hard-coded into generated scaffolds.
